hero.subtitle: LedLink connects LED screen owners with people who want to advertise — catalog, schedule and contracts in one place.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps between an empty screen and a live campaign.

step1.title: The owner lists the screen
step1.text: Location, size, resolution and estimated audience. The screen goes live after approval.

step2.title: The advertiser finds it
step2.text: Filters by city, type and audience. Advertisers see what is free and send an interest request.

step3.title: Both close the deal
step3.text: Contract, period and price recorded on the platform. The screen schedule updates itself.

owners.title: For screen owners
owners.text: Stop tracking screen, client and dates in three different places.
owners.bullet1: A catalog with all your screens
owners.bullet2: A schedule that prevents overlapping contracts
owners.bullet3: Requests and prices recorded, no spreadsheets

advertisers.title: For advertisers
advertisers.text: Find the right screen in the right place without calling five companies.
advertisers.bullet1: Search by city, type and estimated audience
advertisers.bullet2: Clear technical details for every screen
advertisers.bullet3: Interest request in a few clicks
